objective: Cambiar el cliente CANON de cobro múltiple para enviar hasta 20 deudas en un único POST /commands/payment.batch al backend ya desplegado, conservando un child payment.create por deuda, journal durable, retry idempotente y una sola reconciliación posterior.
owner_authorization: El owner reportó ~30 segundos para 14 deudas y autorizó aplicar primeros principios para eliminar viajes de red redundantes.
invariants: Backend /commands/payment.batch is already deployed before this frontend is published.
Each selected debt remains a distinct payment.create child with its own operation_id and receipt.
For up to 20 selected debts the browser performs one payment.batch POST, not N payment.create POSTs.
The remote status read remains before a new batch, preserving the repository invariant that only a new single payment.create may skip it.
ACK-loss retry replays the exact same batch payload and child operation_ids.
No full canonical refresh occurs between child debts.
Exactly one background full reconciliation remains after a confirmed batch.
No business-rule, D1 schema, CSS, Motion or module changes.
rollback: Revertir el frontend PR y desplegar el Hosted POS previo. El backend batch endpoint puede permanecer compatible y sin uso.
